verdict.rationale: Compliance posture is a fair question for a GPU cloud provider, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack covers SOC 2 reports, data-handling policies, a trust center, or datacenter tier certifications. Firewall rules and single-tenant Private Cloud are adjacent security features, not a verifiable compliance posture.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it
